steps: Find your seat in the attached room list: master's 302, PhD 103, integrated 202/204 (Building 301).
Bring photo ID (student card OK) and a black pen; no pencil or correction tape.
Arrive by 09:50; switch off phones and put them in your bag.
Write student ID, name, subject number and page number on every answer sheet.

blocks.en: 1. You must be in the exam room by 09:50. Entry is strictly not allowed after the exam starts at 10:00.
blocks.ko: 1. 입실완료 시간: 09시 50분(시험이 시작되는 10:00 이후 절대 입실 불가).

blocks.en: 2. Check your exam room. After entering the room, sit in your assigned seat.
blocks.ko: 2. 본인 고사장을 확인하고, 고사장 입실 후 본인 지정석에 착석 바랍니다.

blocks.en: 3. You must bring a photo ID (a student ID card is accepted).
blocks.ko: 3. 사진이 있는 신분증(학생증 가능) 지참해야 합니다.

blocks.en: 4. Calculators are allowed, but you may not share them.
blocks.ko: 4. 계산기 사용 가능하나, 공유할 수 없습니다.

blocks.en: 5. Write your answers in black pen. Pencils and correction tape are not allowed.
blocks.ko: 5. 답안은 펜(검정색)으로 작성하여야 합니다(연필 및 수정테이프 사용 불가).

blocks.en: 6. Master's, PhD and integrated MS-PhD students all take 2 subjects. Use 1 answer sheet for each subject.
blocks.ko: 6. 석사, 박사, 석박통합 모두 2과목씩 응시합니다.(과목 별로 답안지 1장씩 사용).

blocks.en: 7. How to fill in the answer sheet
- Write your student ID number and name on every sheet (required)
- Write the number of the subject you chose in the top-left corner (required)
- Write the page number in the bottom-right corner (required)

blocks.en: 1. Put all your belongings in your bag and place it under your desk. You may keep only your ID and writing tools.
blocks.ko: 1. 신분증, 필기구 이외의 모든 소지품은 가방에 넣어 책상 밑에 놓습니다.

blocks.en: 2. Turn off mobile phones and portable electronic devices (electronic watches, tablet PCs, etc.) or remove their batteries, and put them in your bag. ※ If an electronic device makes a sound during the exam, this counts as cheating. You will be asked to leave the room and your exam will be cancelled (marked invalid).
blocks.ko: 2. 휴대폰 및 휴대용 전자기기(전자시계, 태블릿PC 등)는 전원을 끄거나 배터리를 분리하여 가방에 넣도록 합니다. ※ 시험 중 전자기기 소리가 날 경우, 부정행위로 간주하여 퇴실 조치 및 무효 처리됨

blocks.en: 3. Calculators are allowed, but you may not share them.
blocks.ko: 3. 계산기 사용이 가능하나 공유할 수 없습니다.

blocks.en: 1. You must write your student ID number, name and subject number on every answer sheet. Number the pages separately for each subject.
blocks.ko: 1. 답안지마다 학번, 이름, 과목번호를 반드시 기재합니다. 답안지의 면수는 과목별로 기재하여야 합니다.

blocks.en: 2. Only black pens are allowed. Pencils and correction tape are not allowed. To correct an answer, draw a line through it and write the new answer, or ask for a new answer sheet.
blocks.ko: 2. 펜(검정색)만 사용 가능하며, 연필 및 수정테이프 사용 불가입니다. 취소선 긋고 답안 작성하거나 답안지 교체를 요청합니다.

blocks.en: 3. Even if you have finished your answers, you may not leave the room until 1 hour has passed after the exam starts.
blocks.ko: 3. 답안 작성을 완료한 경우라도 시험 시작 후 1시간 경과 전에는 퇴실할 수 없습니다.

blocks.en: 1. When you finish the exam, hand your answer sheets to the exam supervisor and leave the room quietly.
blocks.ko: 1. 시험을 마친 수험생은 답안지를 감독위원에게 제출한 후 조용히 퇴실하여 주시기 바랍니다.

blocks.en: 2. You may take the question paper with you. (Past exam questions will be posted on the intranet.)
blocks.ko: 2. 문제지는 가져갈 수 있습니다.(기출문제: 인트라넷 게시 예정).

english: This is a notice about the 논자시 (thesis qualifying exam) major written exam.
Please make sure to check the details below and the attached files (Instructions for Examinees, How to Fill in the Answer Sheet, Exam Room Guide).
※ You must be seated in the exam room by 09:50. (No entry after the exam starts at 10:00!!)
- Integrated Master's-Doctoral students: Building 301, Rooms 202 and 204
- Photo ID (student ID card is accepted)
- Pencils and correction tape are not allowed.
- Calculators are allowed, but you cannot share them.
- Even if you have finished your answers, you cannot leave the room until 1 hour has passed after the exam starts.

- From the end of October, you can check the result on mySNU (go to 'Mysnu > 학사정보 (Academic Information) > 졸업 (Graduation) > 졸업시험 신청 (Graduation Exam Application) > 종합시험 판정결과 조회 (Comprehensive Exam Result Inquiry)').
